labels.symptom: Imported Lightroom XMP presets have no effect when applied to an image.
Cameras that only use PTP/MTP and don't mount as a disk do not appear in Import from Device.
labels.root_cause: Device discovery only looks at mounted volumes that contain a DCIM folder.

labels.symptom: Renaming photos on a case-insensitive volume changes the sidecar's extension from .xmp to .XMP.
labels.root_cause: sidecars() checks the uppercase .XMP spelling first, and on a case-insensitive volume it matches the lowercase file, so the uppercase spelling is used for the destination.

labels.symptom: Face detection and recognition are slow because they run only on the CPU.
labels.root_cause: The face network interpreter is single-threaded CPU code with no GPU path.

labels.symptom: With a very large catalog, the UI becomes sluggish whenever the left folders/collections panel is open.
The Pick flag is only outlined, so picked photos are hard to tell apart from unpicked ones.
Bug reports from the Help menu open a blank issue without version, system info or logs.
labels.root_cause: Send Feedback only opens a plain issue URL with no diagnostics.

labels.symptom: Face detection fails on stylised or animal faces and custom detectors cannot be plugged in.
Canon CR3 raw files show coloured noise dots in dark areas and greyish blacks.
JPEG images look poor at 100% zoom compared with a system image viewer.
Sony ARW raw files look brighter and warmer than in other raw converters.
Default sharpening looks much stronger than the same amount in the reference app.
labels.root_cause: The amount scale may not be calibrated against the reference app.

labels.symptom: Zooming in the before/after comparison view is unreliable: the zoom area is sometimes offset or shows artifacts.
A passing local CI run does not show which GPU tests were skipped or what hardware was tested.
labels.root_cause: libtest has no skipped status, so GPU tests that return early look the same as tests that passed.

labels.symptom: Exported images can come out one pixel smaller than the requested size.
labels.root_cause: Output size is worked out twice, from catalog dimensions and from a reduced decoded source, and the two round differently.

labels.symptom: Error handling misfires or breaks when error messages are reworded or translated, e.g. offering the wrong model download or mislabeling cancelled tasks.
labels.root_cause: Errors reach the UI as plain strings and the UI matches on English message text instead of typed variants.

labels.symptom: Lens correction profiles cannot be chosen manually when the photo has no lens metadata.
Platform-specific breakage reaches main because tests only run in CI on FreeBSD and GPU equivalence tests never run.
labels.root_cause: CI workflows run cargo test only on FreeBSD and GPU tests refuse software adapters.

labels.symptom: Dragging edit sliders stutters on large libraries.
labels.root_cause: Every catalog op bumps Catalog::revision, which invalidates all library-wide query and sidebar caches.

labels.symptom: Every update throws away the whole thumbnail render cache and re-renders the entire library.
labels.root_cause: A single global RENDER_CACHE_VERSION is part of every cache key.

labels.symptom: Raw photos look washed out, with shadows too bright and too little contrast.
labels.root_cause: The default raw tone curve is flatter than a camera-style S-curve.

labels.symptom: Exposure brackets must be found and HDR-merged by hand, one group at a time.
Sony ARW raw files open with a strong blue cast and wrong colors.
Calibration sliders have too subtle an effect on the image.
Sony ARW raw photos from the Alpha 6000 appear green.
labels.root_cause: Incorrect color matrix or white balance handling for Sony ILCE-6000 raws.

labels.symptom: Highlights/shadows/whites/blacks sliders are much weaker at extremes than Lightroom.
Cannot import Lightroom catalogs.
Importing Lightroom edits silently drops the selected camera profile without telling the user.
labels.root_cause: The XMP importer ignores crs:CameraProfile and doesn't warn about unsupported profiles.

labels.symptom: Imported Lightroom edits with Upright Auto get different framing because saved transforms are ignored.
labels.root_cause: The XMP importer reads PerspectiveUpright but not the saved UprightTransform_* matrices, so it recomputes the geometry.

labels.symptom: Auto light combined with high clarity gives much worse results than the reference app.
Nikon Z 8 raw files render with clipped highlights and muted colors, and the camera's crop is ignored.
labels.root_cause: The NEF decoder ignores the crop metadata, and the default tone and color rendering is weak.

labels.symptom: Imported Nikon NEF raw images look very dark and green.
Samsung NX SRW raw files can't be opened.
There is no way to control when retouch tool overlay pins are shown, and no shortcut to cycle the modes.
In the browser, losing the WebGL context leaves the editor blank with no recovery and no message.
labels.root_cause: There is no handler for webglcontextlost that recreates the context or tells the user.

labels.symptom: There is no plugin support for exporting photos to services like Piwigo.
Canon and Olympus raw files are not supported.
Sony ARW raw photos show a magenta tint and come out too bright.
labels.root_cause: Wrong color matrix or white balance and tone handling for Sony raw files.

labels.symptom: On older Intel Macs the app icon appears briefly and then the app quits without opening.
labels.root_cause: The Metal shader compiler crashes on older Intel integrated GPUs while the wgpu pipeline is being set up.

labels.symptom: External devices such as MIDI controllers cannot drive the app or get its current state back.
labels.root_cause: There is no two-way external control API with state change notifications.

labels.symptom: The masking tools do not work: the brush does nothing, the radial shape cannot be adjusted and the color picker fails.
When the app fails at startup it exits silently and leaves no log on disk that explains why.
labels.root_cause: Logs go only to stderr, which the Windows GUI subsystem throws away, and panic logs land in the temp folder.

labels.symptom: Photos in sub-folders don't show up when you open a parent folder, so you have to click into every sub-folder.
Shadow and highlight recovery on CR2 raw files brings back much less detail than other raw editors do.
iPhone ProRAW files saved with JPEG XL compression open only as their embedded preview, so they can't be edited as raw.
labels.root_cause: The DNG decoder rejects compression 52546 (JPEG XL).

labels.symptom: There is no way to import a whole folder of photos at once.
Catalogs can't be shared over a network by several users or computers.
Sony raw files render with poor color, and the temperature slider doesn't show Kelvin values.
Nikon NEF raw files look very flat and desaturated whatever color profile is applied.
An outside developer offers to collaborate, based on their own Rust photo editor.
There is no in-app plugin panel or plugin system built on the control API.
Sony ARW raw images come out darker, with a strong green tint and the wrong white balance.
Older Panasonic RW2 raw files show only the embedded preview.
labels.root_cause: The RW2 'Format 4' variant is not decoded.

labels.symptom: On Windows with an Intel integrated GPU the app crashes in the Vulkan driver on its second launch, before the window appears.
labels.root_cause: State or cache data saved on exit, probably a pipeline cache, crashes the Intel Vulkan driver at startup.

labels.symptom: Raw photos open underexposed, and auto correction does not fix them.
The sharpening control acts like a dehaze filter instead of sharpening.
On Windows 11 the whole interface flickers whenever the mouse moves, which makes the app unusable.
There is no support for lens correction profiles or a way to generate them.
While moving adjustment sliders the preview becomes blurry, blocky and slow to update.
labels.root_cause: Live preview uses a low-resolution nearest-neighbor downscale that is regenerated slowly.

labels.symptom: HEIC/HEIF images cannot be opened or imported.
labels.root_cause: No HEIF decoder.

labels.symptom: Importing a folder always includes subfolders, bringing in exported JPEG duplicates of RAW files.
labels.root_cause: Import recurses into subdirectories with no option or duplicate detection.

labels.symptom: Thumbnails for imported images are only generated when scrolled into view, leaving black placeholders without progress.
labels.root_cause: Thumbnail generation is lazy and visibility-driven instead of a background job.

labels.symptom: Thumbnails appear slowly during import instead of the preview embedded in the RAW file being shown right away.
The Subject, Background and Sky masks use simple heuristics instead of AI segmentation.
labels.root_cause: These masks use heuristics in masks.rs instead of the SAM model path.

labels.symptom: Sony raw files look badly desaturated under purple or magenta light compared with the camera JPEG.
There are no Fujifilm film simulation camera profiles and no way to import ICC/DCP profiles.
Sorting imported photos by modified date gives an order that does not match the file dates.
If the GPU driver hangs during startup, the window stays black and 'not responding' with no explanation.
labels.root_cause: The renderer creates the GPU device before the first frame, so a driver that blocks there freezes the window before anything is shown.

labels.symptom: Running the same HDR merge twice leaves an orphan DNG behind and the import fails.
On Intel Macs, quitting from the app menu crashes and produces a macOS problem report.
Develop and crop edits are never written back to XMP sidecar files.
labels.root_cause: XMP support only reads sidecars and never writes them.

labels.symptom: The installer does not offer to add a desktop shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The installer has no optional desktop-shortcut step.

labels.symptom: Spatial stereo HEIC photos cannot be detected or filtered in the catalog.
The masking panel and on-canvas mask controls behave differently from the reference app.
Sony A7 (ILCE-7) raw files look posterized and cold at default settings.
labels.root_cause: Decoding or colour handling of compressed ARW files from the ILCE-7 is wrong.

labels.symptom: Canon 5D Mark IV raw files open very dark and desaturated, and the As Shot white balance reads wrong.
labels.root_cause: The camera's colour matrix or profile appears not to be applied correctly.

labels.symptom: No mobile or Android version is available.
With one menu open, hovering over other menu-bar titles does not switch to them; each needs its own click.
labels.root_cause: The in-window menu bar attaches popup menus per title without hover-switch logic.

labels.symptom: Sony A200 raw photos open distorted and glitched.
On macOS a 'quit unexpectedly' crash dialog appears every time the app is closed.
Lytro light-field LFR/LFP raw files cannot be opened.
Photos and edits can't be synced between devices through a self-hosted server.
Canon CR3 raw files can't be decoded, and only the embedded JPEG preview is editable.
labels.root_cause: There is no CR3 decoder.
bug_markers: Cr3 files are not decoded yet

labels.symptom: Only one color profile can be used per camera model, so profiles for different picture styles can't be chosen.
Only the embedded JPEG preview of ORF raw files can be edited, not the raw data.
labels.root_cause: There is no raw decoder for the ORF format.

labels.symptom: Once an aspect ratio is set, the crop box snaps back when you try to move it.
The app cannot be installed or updated through WinGet.
labels.root_cause: No WinGet manifest is published.

labels.symptom: Blacks and Whites sliders stop at ±100, and nothing explains what the scale means.
There is no way to export a sequence of photos as a timelapse video.
Dragging files from another app onto the window does nothing instead of importing them.
labels.root_cause: The window does not handle OS drag-and-drop file drops.

labels.symptom: Opening a file in the app from another program or the system file manager fails with an error that the app can't handle the file.
labels.root_cause: The app does not register or handle OS open-file requests (file associations / open-document events).

labels.symptom: Sony raw files import at a very low resolution with wrong colors.
The Vibrance and Saturation sliders need very large values before they have a visible effect.
Imported Light-panel slider values come out brighter or darker than in Lightroom, especially for process version 11.
labels.root_cause: Tone curve math for exposure, highlights/shadows and whites/blacks differs from Lightroom's process versions.

labels.symptom: Canon CR2 raw files open in grayscale with no color, and the color can't be changed.
Some Sony ARW raw files fail to decode, open as the embedded preview only, or show wrong colours.
labels.root_cause: Raw decoder bugs, plus a dark, grey neutral fallback when the camera-look fit is rejected.

labels.symptom: Highlight recovery turns clipped highlights pink or magenta in iPhone RAW photos.
labels.root_cause: Probably clipped channels are not handled during highlight reconstruction.

labels.symptom: Canon CR3 raw files open only as a preview.
Imported source folders don't appear under Local, and Delete doesn't say whether it removes the photo from the library or deletes the file from disk.
There is no option to expand a photo's canvas or fill content with local generative AI.
Nikon NEF raw files import as solid black images, while JPEGs load fine.
The MCP server fails to start in a second chat because another connection already holds the exclusive library lock, and the error doesn't explain why.
labels.root_cause: The persistent library takes an exclusive lock per process, so concurrent MCP connections can't open it.

labels.symptom: Nikon NEF raw files open with wrong colours.
Every small edit adds a cached image file that shows up as a photo in the system photo viewer, piling up thousands of copies.
labels.root_cause: Thumbnail or preview cache files are written as image files in a folder that photo libraries index.

labels.symptom: The profile list command returns only built-in profiles and leaves out imported LUT profiles.
labels.root_cause: profiles.list only lists built-in profiles and does not include imported .cube profiles.

labels.symptom: The SAM3 model is not installed automatically, and users cannot find where to get it.
With the UI set to Simplified Chinese, many characters show as empty boxes (tofu).
labels.root_cause: Missing CJK glyph coverage in the bundled or fallback fonts.

labels.symptom: Some Sony raw files render much darker and greyer than the camera's JPEG, while near-identical frames render correctly.
Exported images look desaturated compared with the preview, and masking tools are weak.
Dragging files onto the window does nothing on Linux under Wayland.
labels.root_cause: The Wayland backend in winit 0.30 has no file drag-and-drop support, so no DroppedFile events reach egui.

labels.symptom: The repository has no issue templates, so bug reports lack version, OS and reproduction details.
The What's New view shows only the month, not the version number and release date.
Unsupported camera raw files give no hint on how to contribute samples for support.
Raw files from a specific camera and lens show different distortion than the matching in-camera JPEGs.
labels.root_cause: Lens distortion correction is missing or wrong for this camera and lens.

labels.symptom: At 100% zoom the photo preview looks soft because the full-resolution image never loads.
Raw photos imported before a decoder update stay preview-only and keep showing the old 'can't decode' message.
labels.root_cause: The preview_only reason saved in the catalog is never re-checked after the raw decoders improve.

labels.symptom: Compressed Fujifilm RAF raw files can't be opened.
labels.root_cause: The raw decoder doesn't support compressed RAF.

labels.symptom: With the UI language set to Simplified Chinese, most characters appear as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: The bundled UI font has no CJK glyphs and there is no system font fallback.

labels.symptom: HEIC/HEIF photos can't be opened.
labels.root_cause: No HEIF decoder is available.

labels.symptom: No light theme is available for the interface.
The app cannot run on Android or iOS mobile devices.
Photos rendered from smart previews show block artefacts, banding and a colour shift compared with the original.
labels.root_cause: Smart previews are stored as 8-bit sRGB JPEG q92.

labels.symptom: User asks how to install the SAM3 plugin for masks.
On Wayland, automation control requests time out while the display is asleep or the window is fully covered, even though the app is healthy.
labels.root_cause: Control requests are only processed during frame updates, which stop when the compositor sends no frame callbacks to a hidden window.

labels.symptom: Raw files from cameras with known color matrices show relative white balance instead of Kelvin.
labels.root_cause: White-balance scale is chosen by file extension rather than by matrix availability.

labels.symptom: Thai text in folder names and other UI text shows as empty squares.
labels.root_cause: The bundled UI fonts and fallback chain have no Thai glyphs.

labels.symptom: There is no tablet companion app for editing photos on an iPad or other tablet.
On macOS the window's traffic-light controls are out of line with the title bar.
The sharpening Radius and Detail sliders do nothing, and sharpening boosts mid-scale texture instead of fine edges.
labels.root_cause: No pipeline code reads sharpen_radius or sharpen_detail, and the sharpening blur uses the texture blur sigma of about 11 px.

labels.symptom: RAW files from one camera model still render with different color and tone than the reference.
labels.root_cause: The camera color and tone profile for this model doesn't match the reference rendering.

labels.symptom: On Linux with the Nouveau driver, resizing the window crashes the whole desktop session.
labels.root_cause: Surface reconfiguration on resize triggers a GPU page fault in the Nouveau driver under wgpu.

labels.symptom: The Windows installer finishes silently with no success message, so the install looks like it failed.
labels.root_cause: The installer has no completion dialog.

labels.symptom: Creating smart previews shows no progress, and all previews are put in a single folder.
Importing a Lightroom catalog larger than 1 GB fails with a size limit error.
labels.root_cause: Native catalog import is capped at a 1 GiB database/WAL size.

labels.symptom: The grain effect looks pixelated and digital instead of like film grain.
labels.root_cause: The grain is generated as per-pixel noise rather than with an organic, film-like model.

labels.symptom: With a German QWERTZ keyboard, pressing number-row keys does not trigger their shortcuts.
labels.root_cause: Number-key shortcuts may not be matched on non-US keyboard layouts.

labels.symptom: Photos look different in the preview than they do in the system image viewer.
Color noise reduction barely works at the default strength and causes color bleeding at high values.
labels.root_cause: The chroma denoise algorithm is too weak at low settings and not edge-aware.

labels.symptom: Importing a large catalog reads and hashes every original, progress stays near zero and Cancel does nothing until all files are read.
labels.root_cause: Catalog import probes all files in one batch with full-file hashing, a local progress counter and a cancel flag that is never set.

labels.symptom: The desktop app has no guided setup that finds the CLI and produces a working MCP configuration for an agent client.
labels.root_cause: Installing the desktop app and configuring an agent are separate manual steps with no in-app help.

labels.symptom: Desktop installs give no documented, reliable way to run the bundled CLI from scripts or agents without relying on PATH.
labels.root_cause: Each platform's package handles the CLI differently, and macOS ships it as a separate download.

labels.symptom: The interface has no Norwegian translation.
Canon CR3 raw files at high ISO come out much noisier, with blue speckles on dark areas, than the same data converted to DNG.
labels.root_cause: The colour matrix fitted from JPEGs, used for CR3 files without a measured matrix, boosts blue-channel noise about 5x.

labels.symptom: Images exported from Canon CR2 raw files lose saturation and show a shifted hue.
There is no option to remove hot pixels (fireflies) in high-ISO photos.
Phase One IIQ raw files cannot be imported.
labels.root_cause: The IIQ raw format is not supported.

labels.symptom: Imported raw files from several cameras look dull and muddy.
There is no sky replacement tool for photos with flat, overcast skies.
On Raspberry Pi 5 (VideoCore VII) the app exits at startup because the window cannot be opened, with a WGPU limit error.
labels.root_cause: The wgpu device request asks for default limits (max_inter_stage_shader_variables 16) that exceed what the GPU allows (15) instead of using the adapter's limits.

labels.symptom: Sliders cannot be nudged with the scroll wheel or arrow keys, and the mask overlay hides the colour change while a slider is dragged.
Dark, muted raw files open duller than the camera JPEG because only a partial camera look is applied.
labels.root_cause: The quality gates for the camera-look fit seem tuned on bright scenes and reject low-signal scenes.

labels.symptom: Sony A7 II raw files have no built-in camera colour profile and can open looking muted.
labels.root_cause: No calibration data exists for the ILCE-7M2.

labels.symptom: Dark Sony raw files shot with DRO on render brighter than the camera JPEG.
labels.root_cause: The pooled DRO-off tone curve does not match this body or low-key shadows.

labels.symptom: There is no HDR editing mode, HDR histogram, or HDR export to AVIF/JPEG XL.
Bracketed raw exposures cannot be merged into an HDR DNG.
Simplified Chinese text in the interface shows as garbled characters.
labels.root_cause: Missing CJK font fallback or incomplete translations.

labels.symptom: There is no opt-in way to sync a library between devices over storage the user owns.
On Windows and Linux the window lacks the standard custom title bar and caption buttons, and there is no System Title Bar preference.
labels.root_cause: Window decoration handling not standardized to the shared custom title bar architecture.

labels.symptom: The Windows uninstaller shows no message confirming that uninstallation has finished.
On Windows, once a folder is added under one root, the same folder can't be expanded under the other root in the folder browser.
The Windows uninstaller leaves settings and user data behind and has no option to remove everything.
labels.root_cause: The uninstaller does not delete user data directories.

labels.symptom: Some Canon CR3 raw files show only the embedded JPEG preview because decoding fails.
labels.root_cause: The adaptive-QP escape parser misreads later escapes and adds an extra +128 to the residual.

labels.symptom: Some Canon CR3 raw files may decode with wrong coefficients in high-frequency bands.
labels.root_cause: The CRX decoder picks the first HF-band width that fully decodes, but two widths can both align on the same stream.

labels.symptom: The thumbnail cache folder cannot be chosen; it always sits inside the library folder.
labels.root_cause: The thumbnail cache path is hardcoded to <library>/thumbs.

labels.symptom: The Vignette Paint style looks the same as Color, so the style buttons do nothing at default settings.
labels.root_cause: The Paint branch multiplies by the same factor as the Color branch on both the CPU and GPU paths.

labels.symptom: With a non-English UI language, many menus, tooltips and toasts stay in English even though translations exist.
labels.root_cause: Labels are passed straight to egui widgets without going through the i18n tr() lookup.

labels.symptom: Some Nikon D800 raw files show a thin white bar along the top edge.
A panorama merged from RAW photos comes out with a colour or white balance shift.
labels.root_cause: White balance appears to be lost when the RAW files are merged.

labels.symptom: There is no 'Edit in' option to open a photo in an external editor with the current settings.
AI masking runs only on the CPU on Windows and Linux, with no GPU acceleration.
labels.root_cause: SAM 3 inference only has a Metal backend.

labels.symptom: The LRTimelapse round trip is incomplete: crs: values aren't written back and custom white balance isn't honoured.
Holding Alt while dragging the Blacks, Whites or Sharpening sliders shows no clipping preview.
Export can't write each photo to a folder next to its original; only one fixed destination folder is allowed.
Correction tools like red eye, removal, lens correction and denoise are spread across separate tabs instead of grouped workspaces.
Denoising looks stronger in small grid previews than in the single-image view.
labels.root_cause: The denoiser appears to work at preview resolution without scaling for image size.

labels.symptom: Rotating an image 90 degrees keeps the old dimensions, so the image is cropped, even after rotating back.
On macOS, keyboard shortcuts that don't use Cmd don't work.
Clicking an entry in the history panel adds a new nested history entry instead of showing its details.
HDR merges of Canon CR2 raw files come out greenish and muted.
labels.root_cause: The merged DNG gets no ColorMatrix tags because CR2 colour is fitted from the embedded JPEG rather than read from tags.

labels.symptom: The crop and straighten controls use text or inconsistent visuals instead of the icons the other apps use.
On an ARM Linux Chromebook-style device the app process runs but no window appears, and the log shows a software rasterizer warning.
A thin purple bar shows along one edge of imported Nikon RAW photos.
labels.root_cause: Probably the RAW decoder keeps stray border pixels that should be cropped off.

labels.symptom: The tone curve editor doesn't show the image histogram behind the curve.
There is no accurate film stock simulation like spektrafilm.
On macOS the desktop app does not compile and several tests fail.
labels.root_cause: Turning on eframe's glow feature added a second parameter to App::on_exit, and the macOS-only call site was not updated; CI has no macOS job to catch it.

labels.symptom: The crop aspect lock starts unlocked on every photo and after every restart.
labels.root_cause: The last chosen crop aspect is not saved; this is in progress on main but not yet released.

labels.symptom: There is no publish service or plug-in API, so collections can't be kept in sync with an external site such as WordPress.
Sony lossless-compressed raw files render as scrambled vertical bands with a purple cast.
labels.root_cause: Four-component LJ92 tiles were decoded as a row-major sample stream instead of 2×2 CFA cells.

labels.symptom: The thumbnail cache always goes in the library folder, so it is slow when the library is on a network drive.
labels.root_cause: The thumbnail cache location was hard-coded to <library>/thumbs.

labels.symptom: On macOS a test fails because it creates folders whose names are not valid UTF-8, which APFS refuses.
labels.root_cause: APFS rejects non-UTF-8 file names with EILSEQ, and the test unwraps create_dir_all on such a name.

labels.symptom: There is no way to see or choose the backup folder in Settings.
Sidecar repair tests fail on case-insensitive volumes.
labels.root_cause: The tests compare paths exactly, but on case-insensitive disks the sidecar lookup picks the uppercase .XMP variant.

labels.symptom: The photo preview goes blurry while you drag adjustment sliders.
labels.root_cause: While a slider is dragged, the preview always renders at a fixed 0.6 scale, even when the GPU could draw it at full size.

labels.symptom: DNG files cannot be exported with lossy compression.
Several features and Windows fixes are merged in one integration batch.
Importing a Lightroom catalog drops smart collections and folder stacks.
HDR images can't be exported with the HLG curve.
The Export dialog height test fails on macOS.
labels.root_cause: A macOS-only checkbox makes the dialog one row taller than the test expects.

labels.symptom: Sony α99 II raw files have no bundled camera colour profile.
Thumbnails for CR3 and TIFF-based raws read the whole file just to show a small preview.
labels.root_cause: The preview reader doesn't use the sparse range plan, so it reads the whole file.

labels.symptom: Screen readers find unnamed text fields, and sliders that announce no value or range.
labels.root_cause: egui text fields and sliders were not given AccessKit names, values or ranges.

labels.symptom: Importing a large Lightroom catalog looks hung, and Cancel does nothing.
labels.root_cause: The file-reading step reported no progress and ignored cancellation.

labels.symptom: The library is never backed up automatically while it is open or when the app quits.
Colour noise reduction uses a lot of memory and time on large photos.
labels.root_cause: Chromaticity was blurred at full resolution in a full-size buffer.

labels.symptom: Soft proofing at 1:1 or higher zoom is slow because the whole frame is rendered.
labels.root_cause: Soft proof rendered the full frame instead of a zoom window.

labels.symptom: Some Canon CR3 raw files from newer cameras aren't verified and have wrong white balance.
The preview shows a placeholder image while rendering with no indication it is not final.
Pen pressure does not affect brush mask size or flow.
Old library backups are never removed automatically.
With a monitor color profile set, zoomed 1:1 views are blurry.
labels.root_cause: Zoom tiles were recorded under the render key before the display profile changed it, so lookup failed.

labels.symptom: Handles drawn on the canvas cannot be focused or moved with the keyboard.
Minolta MRW raw files open as preview only instead of decoding from sensor data.
Exported images come out one pixel smaller than the requested size on one edge.
labels.root_cause: The rounded export size was fitted a second time against the source aspect ratio, which lost a pixel to rounding.

labels.symptom: Restore Library from Backup opens a folder dialog instead of listing the available backups.
Raw files from some older Nikon COOLPIX models decode wrongly.
Edited photos cannot be exported as a rendered DNG.
On Linux, previews ignore the display color profile assigned in the desktop's color settings.
labels.root_cause: The display profile from colord was never read.

labels.symptom: On case-insensitive disks, renaming or saving gives files the wrong letter case or reports collisions that don't exist.
labels.root_cause: File-exists checks with different letter case return true on case-insensitive volumes, and same_file was not symmetric on Windows.

labels.symptom: Raw files from older Nikon cameras show a thin coloured or dark bar along one edge.
labels.root_cause: Masked sensor columns were kept because these NEFs record no CropArea, and only the trailing dark columns were trimmed.

labels.symptom: Catalogs replaced by restores pile up forever in the library folder.
labels.root_cause: Nothing ever removed the Replaced folders.

labels.symptom: With thousands of presets, every slider move and panel interaction takes seconds.
labels.root_cause: The whole preset list was serialized on every command, and every preset row was rebuilt each frame.

labels.symptom: The vignette's Paint Overlay style looks the same as Color Priority.
labels.root_cause: The shader applied the same highlight protection to both styles when darkening.

labels.symptom: Film grain looks like flat noise and changes with output resolution.
labels.root_cause: Grain was a value-noise overlay rather than a particle model.

labels.symptom: Export has no option to save files in the same folder as the original photo.
Local adjustment (mask effect) presets cannot be saved, managed, or imported from Lightroom Classic.
FreeBSD CI tests time out or fail when they call git on the synced checkout.
labels.root_cause: The workflow had no git installed, did not mark the checkout as safe.directory, and gave the VM only 2 vCPUs.

labels.symptom: The interface has no Japanese menus, and text watermarks cannot be set vertically or show Japanese glyphs.

labels.symptom: Cache cleanup deletes unrelated files in the thumbnail folder.

labels.symptom: On case-sensitive file systems, a rename that only changes letter case can overwrite a different file.

labels.symptom: A rename that fails partway leaves photos showing as missing, and Find Missing can't recover them.
labels.root_cause: Rollback errors were ignored, and Find Missing matched only by name and size.

labels.symptom: Renaming one of two files that share a sidecar takes the sidecar away from the other file.

labels.symptom: Saving metadata replaces an existing XMP sidecar and loses other apps' data.

labels.symptom: After a failed save is retried, later edits are set aside as log damage.
labels.root_cause: A partial append was not truncated before the retry, so the retried record shared a line with the fragment.

labels.symptom: Older versions partly misread libraries written by newer versions and drop the new data.
labels.root_cause: New journal ops and fields were added without raising the catalog format version.

labels.symptom: Two processes can open the same library and silently overwrite each other's edits.
labels.root_cause: Nothing took an exclusive lock on the library folder.

labels.symptom: When the saved document or library can't be opened at startup, the app quietly starts an unsaved demo session and all work in it is lost on quit.
labels.root_cause: Errors from opening the library fell back to an in-memory demo session, and the only report was an eprintln.

labels.symptom: Damaged or unreadable settings files quietly reset to defaults and get overwritten, and quitting with unsaved changes gives no warning.
labels.root_cause: Read or parse errors on settings files were treated as missing files, and ui.json was not written atomically.

labels.symptom: A web page open in the browser could send commands to the local automation port, because the port keeps reading after it gets input that isn't a command.

labels.symptom: Renaming or moving a folder can't be undone.

labels.symptom: The photo preview flickers when hovering over presets and profiles.

labels.symptom: The interface has no Russian translation.

labels.symptom: A throwaway in-memory session still saves UI settings and leaves an empty settings folder behind, even though it says nothing is saved.

labels.symptom: The app crashes when it shows a file whose name has CJK or other multi-byte characters.

labels.symptom: In the filmstrip only the active photo looks selected after Select All or a multi-selection.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window with no layout.

labels.symptom: WhiteIsZero grayscale TIFFs open as negatives, and 1-, 2- and 4-bit TIFFs fail to open.
