labels.symptom: Adds DNG support for JPEG XL tiles, gain table maps, semantic mattes, BaselineSharpness and camera-space white balance.
Some Nikon Coolpix and Fujifilm RAW photos open as scrambled images.
labels.root_cause: 12-bit samples packed MSB-first in 32-bit little-endian words were read as a plain byte stream, and the NRW black level was ignored.

labels.symptom: Browsing a large folder or network folder freezes the window for a long time with no progress shown.
labels.root_cause: Listing, probing and importing the folder, and the missing-file count, all ran on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: CR3 photos shot at an in-camera aspect ratio show the full sensor area instead of the chosen crop.
labels.root_cause: The CR3 reader ignored the AspectInfo tag in the Canon maker note.

labels.symptom: Importing photos with foreign XMP silently drops camera profiles and Upright geometry, with no warning.
Integration merge that combines several contributor PRs.
Filename template tokens appear literally in exported file names.
labels.root_cause: Export used its own limited token expander instead of the shared rename template language.

labels.symptom: Album tree organisation and remote AI masks are missing.
Choosing Quit from the macOS menu bar sometimes crashes the app with a SIGILL crash report.
labels.root_cause: Sending ViewportCommand::Close while AppKit is already shutting the app down races with winit's window teardown.

labels.symptom: FreeBSD CI test runs time out because tests are very slow.
labels.root_cause: Many loupe tests regenerate a 24 MP procedural demo photo from scratch on the shared rayon pool, starving other tests.

labels.symptom: DNG files with lossy JPEG XL tiles show a nearly black, clipped picture.
labels.root_cause: Lossy JXL tiles failed to decode and were silently left black, and the other tiles were clipped to 1.0.

labels.symptom: Hasselblad 3FR raw files cannot be imported or show only the preview.
labels.root_cause: The 3FR raw data was not decoded.

labels.symptom: A radial mask can only be moved from its centre pin, not by dragging inside it.
Active filters are not shown, so a filtered empty view looks like an empty folder.
After deleting photos the selection jumps back to the first photo instead of staying near the deleted ones.
labels.root_cause: The delete command always selected the first photo in the current view.

labels.symptom: Older Pentax and Samsung GX-1L PEF files open only as a preview image.
labels.root_cause: The raw strips are tagged as PackBits but actually hold plain packed 12-bit samples, which the reader did not handle.

labels.symptom: Samsung SRW raw files open only as their embedded JPEG.
Local sidebar locations cannot be hidden or removed.
Simplified Chinese text shows up as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: No bundled font had Simplified Chinese glyphs; a CJK SC fallback font was missing.

labels.symptom: Automation clients lack core MCP tools, export progress and cancellation.
Canon EOS R7 C-RAW files open only from the embedded JPEG.
labels.root_cause: The CRX decoder rejected adaptive QP maps with an odd number of rows.
bug_markers: adaptive QP map with an odd height

labels.symptom: Photos without a capture date are listed under the date they were imported.
labels.root_cause: Date grouping, sorting and filtering fell back to the import date when no capture date existed.

labels.symptom: Many Pentax PEF raw photos show with red and blue swapped.
labels.root_cause: The PEF reader assumed a BGGR layout instead of reading the Exif CFAPattern for Huffman-compressed files.

labels.symptom: Corrupted test corpus downloads are not detected.
labels.root_cause: Corpus file hashes were not verified after download.

labels.symptom: In the browser version, if the browser refuses the single-tab lock, the page stays on the loading screen forever with no error.
labels.root_cause: The startup code waited on a promise that was never rejected when navigator.locks.request threw or returned a rejected promise.

labels.symptom: Restoring a tampered backup accepts swapped original images, so exports give the wrong image.
labels.root_cause: Restore checked entries only against the zip CRC, not against the content hash in their storage key.

labels.symptom: The smart previews folder cannot be moved separately from the library.
TIFF files that carry camera EXIF tags don't show up in the browser grid.
labels.root_cause: The raw probe treated TIFFs as camera RAW files based on the Make tag alone, without checking for CFA data.

labels.symptom: Sony A200/A230/A350 raw files develop as pure colour noise.
labels.root_cause: The ARW reader accepted packed strips of the wrong size as one byte per pixel.
fixed_markers: Sony ARW version 1 / packed compressed variant

labels.symptom: On some Windows PCs the app exits at startup with code 1 and never opens a window, reporting that the parent device is lost.
labels.root_cause: wgpu's default DX12 compiler setting (Auto) loads whatever stray dxcompiler.dll is on the search path, and an old copy without dxil.dll makes shader compilation fail.

labels.symptom: Importing a Lightroom catalog drops every crop.
labels.root_cause: Catalogs store crop edges without a HasCrop flag, and the mapper applied a crop only when HasCrop was true.

labels.symptom: The top-level menu headings in the window are too close together to read and click easily.
labels.root_cause: Menu headings are frameless egui buttons with no padding, and no extra item spacing was added between them.

labels.symptom: Canon sRAW and mRAW CR2 files open only from the embedded preview.
labels.root_cause: The CR2 reader rejected raw type 4, which stores subsampled YCbCr.

labels.symptom: Crops imported from a Lightroom catalog land on the wrong axes for portrait or rotated photos.
labels.root_cause: Crop edges are stored for the unrotated image, but the import did not map them through the photo's orientation.

labels.symptom: In narrow panes, long folder breadcrumbs in the import header overlap the import buttons and photo count.
labels.root_cause: The header put the path, count and action controls on one row that never wrapped, with no width limit.

labels.symptom: Straightened crops imported from a Lightroom catalog come out the wrong shape and size.
labels.root_cause: The crop edges were treated as an axis-aligned rectangle when they are the corners of a tilted crop, and the angle's sign was not flipped.

labels.symptom: Sony A7R IVA raw files show no embedded lens distortion correction.
labels.root_cause: The embedded distortion table in the raw IFD (tag 0x7037) was not decoded.

labels.symptom: Raw photos show posterized patches with hard edges in their starting look.
labels.root_cause: The tone-curve fit could produce flat steps.

labels.symptom: Clicking the image to zoom jumps straight to a fixed 100% with no animation and no choice of zoom level.
License files and brand terms don't follow the shared licensing standard.
On Apple Silicon Macs, GPU denoising gives huge or non-finite values that do not match the CPU result.
labels.root_cause: Several shader invocations wrote individual lanes of the same shared workgroup vec4, which is a data race in WGSL.

labels.symptom: Shifting capture times shifts photos by the wrong amount when a photo has an impossible date such as February 30.
labels.root_cause: Impossible calendar dates rolled over into the next month instead of being rejected.

labels.symptom: Exporting a batch of photos is slow and leaves most CPU cores idle.
labels.root_cause: run_batch exported photos strictly one at a time.

labels.symptom: Deleting a folder that contains albums does nothing.
labels.root_cause: Deletion failed with "folder is not empty" and the context menu discarded the error.

labels.symptom: GoPro GPR raw files import but cannot be opened, and the only reason given is a vague "TIFF compression 9" error.
labels.root_cause: VC-5 compressed DNGs are not decoded and fell through to a generic compression error.

labels.symptom: The bracket keys in the grid do not raise or lower photo ratings.
labels.root_cause: Obsolete saved shortcut entries suppressed the default bracket bindings.

labels.symptom: Copyright status, rights usage terms and copyright info URL metadata cannot be edited or kept.
Several raw formats decoded with wrong colours, crops or only as previews.
labels.root_cause: Merges several fixes to the raw decoders.

labels.symptom: Merges several fixes: catalog crop import, narrow import header, macOS quit crash, DX12 startup failure and the web lock hang.
Some JPEG XL DNG files show as a purple grid of four small copies of the photo.
labels.root_cause: DNG 1.7 row and column interleave factors were ignored, so the raster was read without undoing the interleave.

labels.symptom: Default raw renders look darker and less saturated than the reference application.
labels.root_cause: The default tone curve was tuned by eye and lost chroma.

labels.symptom: No user-visible change: a never-crash contributor rule and clippy.toml were added.
The Windows MSI installs silently with no completion message and no choice of install folder.
labels.root_cause: The WiX installer had no UI sequence at all.

labels.symptom: The red mask overlay stays over the photo while local adjustment sliders are moved, hiding their effect.
labels.root_cause: The overlay was not hidden after a successful mask adjustment.

labels.symptom: Raw files from the Sony A7C R had no test samples confirming they decode correctly.
Some Sony A7C R raw photos open grey and muted when the automatic colour fit fails.
labels.root_cause: There was no bundled camera colour profile to fall back on when the per-file fit failed.

labels.symptom: Subtracting from a mask with a brush, or creating a new brush mask, has no effect.
labels.root_cause: Subtract > Brush switched to Erase mode, and a new brush mask reused the current mask.

labels.symptom: Raw photos without a colour matrix come out with dull colours compared with the camera's JPEG.
labels.root_cause: Clipped sensor pixels were included when fitting the camera look to the embedded JPEG.

labels.symptom: Malformed camera raw files could crash the app while decoding.
labels.root_cause: Raw decoders used expect/unreachable on input-derived data.

labels.symptom: A preset that includes grain does nothing when applied at less or more than full strength.
labels.root_cause: Preset amount scaling interpolated the integer grain seed as a float, so deserialization failed and the whole preset was silently dropped.

labels.symptom: Camera calibration rejects every Sony A7R IV raw file, so no profile can be made for it.
labels.root_cause: The camera JPEG proxy kept its own aspect ratio and came out one pixel smaller than the sensor proxy, so the sizes never matched.

labels.symptom: Changing the default look would also change every existing edit.
labels.root_cause: Edits did not record which rendering process they were made with.

labels.symptom: The smart album rule editor has few fields and no validation or date picker.
There is no map view for geotagged photos.
Date-group labels whose keys contain multi-byte characters could crash the app.
labels.root_cause: Byte slicing landed in the middle of a UTF-8 character.

labels.symptom: Raw photos with a Custom white balance from Lightroom import with a strong blue cast.
labels.root_cause: The Kelvin value was read as absolute instead of being converted to a shift from the as-shot white balance on relative-WB raws.

labels.symptom: The interface cannot be shown in French.
Some older Sony raw files look dark and crushed, and small-size lossless raws have hazy, lifted shadows.
labels.root_cause: The SR2 black level was read from a fixed offset that is wrong for some directory layouts, and the wrong pedestal was subtracted for lossless M/S files.

labels.symptom: Integration merge of several contributor fixes.
Several raw-format and corpus improvements are merged together.
Zoom and pan reset while masking, and the automatic sky mask has rough edges.
labels.root_cause: Masking interactions reset the view state.

labels.symptom: On Windows, clicking a folder breadcrumb opens the wrong folder for network shares or drive roots.
labels.root_cause: The breadcrumb path was rebuilt by joining names with '/', which drops the UNC prefix and leaves a bare drive letter without its root separator.

labels.symptom: If the GPU device is lost or runs out of memory during a render, the app crashes instead of falling back to CPU rendering.
labels.root_cause: A failed GPU readback called panic!/expect instead of marking the GPU broken and returning.

labels.symptom: In the crop tool you can't tell where dragging will rotate the photo, and you can't type an exact angle.
Batch merge of MCP tools and camera local tone mapping.
Hasselblad FFF and older 3FR raw files fail to decode.
labels.root_cause: Lossless JPEG with predictor selection value 8 (Hasselblad variant) was not supported.

labels.symptom: Loading the demo photos can hang the app forever.
labels.root_cause: The scene was rendered on rayon inside OnceLock::get_or_init, so a worker could wait on the same cell further down its own stack and deadlock.

labels.symptom: No user-visible change: unreachable panics in the colour, geometry and pipeline code were removed.
Raw files without a colour matrix get inaccurate starting colours.
labels.root_cause: No per-model colour matrices existed for cameras lacking embedded matrices.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V don't work in text boxes, and Esc or Return don't behave as expected in some fields.
labels.root_cause: Each text field was set up on its own, with no shared clipboard or key handling.

labels.symptom: Edits made through the command line or automation server get a fixed fake timestamp.
labels.root_cause: Headless sessions kept the default fixed test clock instead of using the system clock.

labels.symptom: There is no way to export a contact sheet of photos to PDF.
The interface cannot be shown in Ukrainian.
Sony raw photos shot with DRO open too bright, with lifted shadows.
labels.root_cause: The starting tone was fitted to the camera JPEG, which has DRO applied, so its lifted shadows carried over to the raw.

labels.symptom: No user-visible change: impossible panic paths in the engine and MCP code were removed.
Ctrl+= and Ctrl+- scale the whole interface instead of zooming the document, and Ctrl+0 resets the interface scale.
labels.root_cause: egui's zoom_with_keyboard option was left at its default, so egui took the zoom shortcuts for its own interface zoom.

labels.symptom: Photos imported earlier stay without lens correction even after Reload from Disk.
labels.root_cause: Embedded lens data was read only at import time, and Reload from Disk did not update it.

labels.symptom: Permanently deleting a photo resets the selection to the top of the grid and loses your scroll position.
labels.root_cause: Permanent deletion did not use the selection logic that keeps the next surviving photo selected.

labels.symptom: Codex users have no concrete instructions for registering the MCP server against a headless library or the running desktop app.
labels.root_cause: Documentation only gave a generic stdio configuration example.

labels.symptom: Raw files from older Sony cameras open green or with the wrong white balance.
labels.root_cause: The white balance was not read from the encrypted SR2SubIFD, or was read from the wrong source.

labels.symptom: Keywords cannot be created, edited or reorganized unless a photo already has them.
A single failing command closes the whole app and unsaved work is lost, with no crash trace on Windows.
labels.root_cause: Nothing caught panics around command execution, and release builds without a console had no panic log.

labels.symptom: 16:9 Sony raw files open uncropped at 3:2 and look dark and grey.
labels.root_cause: The decoder ignored the 16:9 crop on bodies that have no crop tags and relied on FullImageSize or a 64 px trim limit.

labels.symptom: Imported XMP settings apply partial red/green/blue tone curves that the reference app ignores.
labels.root_cause: Channel curves were read whenever any were present, instead of only when the master curve and all three channel curves are present.

labels.symptom: Some raw photos open dark and grey when the camera look fit is rejected.
labels.root_cause: The only fallback after a failed fit was the neutral rendering.

labels.symptom: Building or running from the Nix flake fails because a required CJK UI font is missing.
labels.root_cause: The flake pinned an old craft-fonts revision that predates the Noto Sans CJK SC font the build script now requires.

labels.symptom: With several photos selected, the keywording box shows only the active photo's keywords.
labels.root_cause: The chips came from the active photo, while add and remove acted on the whole selection.

labels.symptom: Blown highlights in some phone DNGs turn magenta.
labels.root_cause: The sensor clips below the DNG's stated white level, so the clipped samples were not treated as clipped.

labels.symptom: Photos cannot be imported from a self-hosted Immich server.
Keyword sets cannot be edited in place or renamed.
If a background merge fails unexpectedly, the 'Merging…' status stays on screen forever, and missing tasks or a missing browser window can crash the app.
labels.root_cause: The worker's panic dropped its channel, and the poller read the disconnect as 'still running'. Separately, expect() calls on task and window handles crashed the app.

labels.symptom: Smart previews built before a colour-fit change keep the old look.
labels.root_cause: Smart previews did not record which camera-look fit version produced them.

labels.symptom: Keyword lists cannot be imported or exported in the standard text format.
Downsized exports are lower quality than the reference app's because they render directly at the target size in 8 bits.
labels.root_cause: Exports rendered at the output size in 8-bit, with no supersampled downscale.

labels.symptom: Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: Releases ship only standalone Flatpak bundles with no hosted OSTree repository.

labels.symptom: Folders in the sidebar cannot carry colour labels.
Vibrance and Saturation give different results from the reference app.
While zoomed in, the grab hand cursor shows over the side-panel sliders instead of their own cursor.
labels.root_cause: The grab cursor was set every frame after the panels were drawn, regardless of where the pointer was.

labels.symptom: Photos can't be geotagged from a GPX track log.
Raw files from old Olympus compacts open as preview only.
labels.root_cause: The two-field interleaved 12-bit uncompressed strip layout was not recognised.

labels.symptom: Long-running tasks have no single, consistent progress indicator with cancel.
labels.root_cause: Each background job reported progress separately.

labels.symptom: High Efficiency Nikon raw files open preview only with a misleading error about a missing linearization table.
labels.root_cause: The TicoRAW-based HE compression was not detected, so the wrong error was reported.

labels.symptom: There is no way to synchronize a library folder with the files on disk.
Darkening clipped highlights produces a magenta or teal colour cast instead of white.
labels.root_cause: Clipped pixels were rebuilt at raw decode with a hue that the tone map had hidden until the image was darkened.

labels.symptom: Headless UI import tests fail on timing or click the wrong place because layout was not settled.
labels.root_cause: Font and layout initialisation ran inside the timed loop, and clicks used a stale layout.

labels.symptom: HEIC photos decode with wrong colours or are not supported in release builds.
labels.root_cause: heic-rs ignored the HEVC VUI and assumed BT.709 limited range, and the heif feature was off in release packaging.

labels.symptom: CI fails on stable Rust 1.99 because of new clippy lints.
labels.root_cause: Clippy 1.99 added chunks_exact_to_as_chunks and widened question_mark.

labels.symptom: On wide-gamut or calibrated monitors, images look oversaturated because previews ignore the monitor profile.
labels.root_cause: Every preview was shown as sRGB with no display ICC transform.

labels.symptom: Apple ProRAW tone sliders render differently from the reference app.
Canon CR2 raws render with crushed shadows because the black level is too high.
labels.root_cause: The black level averaged border columns that already receive light.

labels.symptom: Olympus raws open flat, grey and dark.
labels.root_cause: ORF was not in the list of formats whose look is fitted to the camera JPEG.

labels.symptom: Crop forgets the last aspect ratio when moving to another photo.
Checking for missing photos stats tens of thousands of non-library files on the UI thread.
labels.root_cause: The missing-file check walked every catalog record, including Local browse records, not just library photos.

labels.symptom: CI workflows print Node 20 deprecation warnings for outdated GitHub Actions.
labels.root_cause: Workflow files pin GitHub Actions versions that run on the deprecated Node 20 runtime.

labels.symptom: People who install a release can't find where the CLI is to register the MCP server, because the docs only cover source builds.
labels.root_cause: MCP docs only describe the target/release path from a source build; installers don't add the CLI to PATH.

labels.symptom: Sony Compressed RAW 2 ARW files show only their embedded JPEG instead of a full decode.
labels.root_cause: There was no decoder for TIFF compression 32766 (LLVC).

labels.symptom: Auto tone makes photos much brighter than the reference app's Auto and barely lifts shadows.
labels.root_cause: Auto used a simple percentile rule instead of a calibrated log-average luminance rule.

labels.symptom: The Calibration sliders render differently from the reference app, and Shadows Tint also changes JPEGs.
The sidebar slows down with smart albums because their counts are recomputed every frame.
labels.root_cause: Each smart-album count scanned the whole catalog and allocated the matching ids during layout.

labels.symptom: Some Nikon NEF raw files fail with "lossy after split" and show only the embedded preview.
labels.root_cause: The decoder did not support the fixed-rate code Nikon switches to after the split row.

labels.symptom: The app is missing from the Omarchy app catalog.
labels.root_cause: There was no OmaStore manifest.

labels.symptom: On Windows the same folder shows up twice in the sidebar's location list.
labels.root_cause: Folder paths were compared as raw strings, without normalising separators or letter case.

labels.symptom: Sony DSC-R1 .SR2 raw files show up as noise.
labels.root_cause: Big-endian 16-bit samples inside a little-endian TIFF were read in the file's byte order.

labels.symptom: Catalogs shared between machines get colliding photo ids.
labels.root_cause: Ids come from a sequential counter.

labels.symptom: Exported photos cannot be added to Apple Photos.
Lowering Highlights or raising Shadows flattens fine detail in bright or dark areas instead of only changing their tone.
labels.root_cause: The edge-aware guided-filter base layer kept thin strong edges, so thin detail got a different tone shift than its surroundings.

labels.symptom: Photos can't be edited or exported in HDR (gain map JPEG, PQ AVIF, float TIFF).
Browsing into a subfolder replaces the chosen Local root, so its parent folders and siblings disappear from the sidebar.
labels.root_cause: The sidebar kept a single custom root and replaced it with whichever folder was browsed.

labels.symptom: Older Olympus ORF raw files show fine vertical stripes and a magenta cast.
labels.root_cause: The padded 12.8 bpp layout was sent to the 12-bit path, which ignores the pad byte.

labels.symptom: On large or HiDPI windows the zoomed image is sharp only in a centre band and blurry at the sides.
labels.root_cause: The GPU texture limit was read from the frame's raw input, which egui-winit fills only on the first frame, so later frames fell back to 2048.

labels.symptom: The app crashes inside the GPU driver when it quits while a render is running.
labels.root_cause: Detached worker threads kept GPU work running while the process exited, with no shutdown gate.

labels.symptom: Many community contributions are merged in one batch.
Integration of the fixes for the highlight colour cast, blurry zoom strips and a GPU crash on quit.
In the in-window File menu, other commands appear below Quit.
labels.root_cause: Registered commands missing from the explicit menu layout were appended after Quit.

labels.symptom: Imported LUT profiles are missing from the profile list command.
labels.root_cause: profiles.list enumerated only the built-in profiles and skipped the session's imported ones.

labels.symptom: The HDR edit mode setting from Lightroom XMP is not imported.
HDR edits cannot be exported as HDR PNG.
Hovering the rating stars shows no preview or hover effect.
labels.root_cause: The star widget worked out the hovered star and then discarded it.

labels.symptom: The command-line and headless sessions ignore the configured segmentation model folder, so AI masks fail.
labels.root_cause: Only the desktop app set the model folder; headless sessions never initialised it.

labels.symptom: Importing a Lightroom catalog copied from another computer shows every original as missing.
labels.root_cause: The importer used only the root folder's absolute path and ignored relativePathFromCatalog.

labels.symptom: Menus lag on Windows because the app scans drives for camera cards while drawing them.
labels.root_cause: Device discovery scanned every drive on the UI thread, holding the cache mutex, each time the menu was rebuilt and the cache had expired.

labels.symptom: Some Nikon NEFs show only the embedded JPEG with the error 'Nikon compressed NEF without a linearization table'.
labels.root_cause: NEFs tagged compression 34713 but stored as packed uncompressed 12/14-bit data were rejected.
bug_markers: Nikon compressed NEF without a linearization table

labels.symptom: Raw files from certain old Nikon Coolpix cameras show as two squashed desaturated copies stacked vertically.
labels.root_cause: Decoder did not de-interlace two-field NEF layout or handle CYGM filter.

labels.symptom: Nikon small raw (sRAW) NEF files are refused instead of opening.
labels.root_cause: The NEF decoder did not handle the half-resolution YCbCr 4:2:2 layout of sRAW files.
bug_markers: Nikon small raw (sRAW) not decoded yet

labels.symptom: The histogram for HDR edits shows only the SDR range.
A catalog lock test sometimes fails on a busy machine.
labels.root_cause: A child process spawned by another test briefly inherits the flock file descriptor before exec closes it.

labels.symptom: The side panels cannot be resized by dragging their edges.
labels.root_cause: The panels had an exact width and were set to resizable(false).

labels.symptom: There are no light themes and no option to follow the system's light or dark appearance.
Right-click Add to Album shows an empty submenu when no album exists.
labels.root_cause: The grid context menu had no New Album… entry.

labels.symptom: Opening or thumbnailing a crafted DNG crashes the app because it runs out of memory.
labels.root_cause: The bad-pixel opcodes listed pixels without a cap or with a cap checked too late.

labels.symptom: Reading an XML file with a huge number of attributes on one element hangs for tens of seconds.
labels.root_cause: quick-xml's attribute duplicate check takes quadratic time (RUSTSEC-2026-0194).

labels.symptom: The HDR switch is a checkbox in the Light panel instead of a button in the Edit panel header.
Raws from the Sony DSC-R1 lose their black level, white balance and crop.
labels.root_cause: The SR2SubIFD was encrypted under a key other than the one known, so it was skipped.

labels.symptom: When a mask is selected, the left side of the right sidebar's contents is cut off.
labels.root_cause: A non-wrapping button row and a fixed-size tile grid were wider than the panel.

labels.symptom: Adding browsed local photos to an album makes the album look empty despite a nonzero count.
labels.root_cause: Album commands accepted local photos that album views never display.

labels.symptom: Integration of several community changes for raw decoding, previews and progress UI.
On Intel Macs the app can crash on every launch while compiling GPU shaders.
labels.root_cause: Apple's Intel Metal compiler aborts on compute kernels' max workgroup size metadata, and some kernel builds ran outside the crash marker.

labels.symptom: Sony raws with a non-3:2 crop get the wrong lens distortion correction.
labels.root_cause: The validation guard checked the table geometry but not the framing of the image crop.

labels.symptom: In a menu that scrolls, the scrollbar covers the shortcut text, so its last character is cut off.
labels.root_cause: egui's ScrollArea floating scrollbar is drawn over the right edge of the rows.

labels.symptom: Face recognition can be switched on even though no recognition model is chosen.
labels.root_cause: The setting had no check that a recognition model was chosen and installed.

labels.symptom: Some low-contrast raw photos render much darker and greyer than their camera JPEG.
labels.root_cause: The tone fit rejects any curve when the scene's bright-to-dark luminance ratio is below 1.5, so these photos get no camera look.

labels.symptom: Photos with no embedded capture date are dated by import day even though their XMP sidecar has a capture time.
labels.root_cause: Merging the sidecar did not copy its capture time into the photo's captured field.

labels.symptom: Kodak DCS520C raw files fail to import.
Lightroom spot removal edits are lost when reading sidecars and presets.
There is no automatic way to find and heal small skin blemishes on faces in portraits.
Users cannot find which template tags the rename field supports.
labels.root_cause: The dialog showed only a placeholder example and gave no help on tags.

labels.symptom: Right after a document or library is closed, opening it again can fail with 'already open in another program'.
labels.root_cause: The flock-based lock was released by closing the file handle, but a child process spawned at the same moment inherited the descriptor and kept the lock held until it exec'd.

labels.symptom: Sony compressed M-size raw files look washed out with a color cast on import.
labels.root_cause: Wrong black level for Sony lossless M/S raw coding left a pedestal under the image.

labels.symptom: A test of the GPU-to-CPU fallback fails at random because other renders overwrite the shared fallback state.
labels.root_cause: The reason for a GPU fallback was kept in one value for the whole process, so any other render could overwrite it, and injected faults switched the GPU off for every thread.

labels.symptom: Compressed Olympus ORF raw files only show a preview.
Some interface labels stay in English when the UI language is Chinese.
labels.root_cause: UI strings were hardcoded instead of wrapped in translation calls.

labels.symptom: Import cannot organise copied photos into a custom date folder layout such as YYYY/YYYYMMDD.
labels.root_cause: Only fixed folder presets were supported.

labels.symptom: Holding Shift while dragging a crop handle does not keep the crop's proportions.
labels.root_cause: The crop drag ignored modifier keys.

labels.symptom: On Wayland, file dialogs open as separate windows that can be hidden behind the fullscreen app, so the app looks frozen.
labels.root_cause: rfd file dialogs were created with no parent window, so the desktop portal could not attach them to the app window.
bug_markers: Failed to associate portal window with parent window

labels.symptom: On Linux the open-file dialog does not show files with upper-case extensions such as .JPG.
labels.root_cause: File-dialog filters used lower-case extension globs, and GTK and the portal match them case-sensitively.

labels.symptom: Some interface strings show in English while a translated language is selected.
labels.root_cause: Translation catalogs contain English source text copied verbatim as the translated values.

labels.symptom: Importing a deleted photo again is skipped as a duplicate even though the photo shows as deleted.
labels.root_cause: The import rule for files that match a trashed photo defaulted to Skip.

labels.symptom: Importing compressed Nikon raw files is very slow.
labels.root_cause: The header probe decoded the whole Huffman stream.

labels.symptom: In the web build, render jobs hang when one background worker fails to start.
labels.root_cause: Worker callbacks captured the loop index, so after one failed start every later worker's replies went to the wrong slot.

labels.symptom: A photo being denoised shows as done while the denoise activity still says it is busy.
labels.root_cause: A poll marked the photo Ready as soon as its file appeared on disk, before the job had reported its result.

labels.symptom: The way to import photos is hard to find and gets confused with adding a sidebar folder.
labels.root_cause: The File menu labelled import as Add Photos/Add Folder and the review dialog did not explain its source or transfer mode.

labels.symptom: Some camera raw previews show muted colour.
labels.root_cause: Partial camera looks with an identity matrix bypass the measured calibration.

labels.symptom: Fujifilm raw files open without their built-in lens distortion and vignetting corrections.
On Wayland desktops, dragging files from the file manager onto the window shows a 'no' cursor and the drop does nothing.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 has no Wayland drag-and-drop, so drops only work through X11/XWayland.

labels.symptom: Dark wedges appear inside the crop box when the crop is rotated.
labels.root_cause: The dimming outside the box was drawn as four quads that cross the box when rotated.

labels.symptom: In side-by-side Before/After, clicking the Before view with the white balance picker samples the wrong point.
labels.root_cause: Clicks in the Before pane were mapped through the After view's rectangle.

labels.symptom: In Compare, a filmstrip click makes a hidden photo active, so edits and ratings go to it.
labels.root_cause: The click set the active photo without putting it on a side.

labels.symptom: The White Balance Selector button does nothing in Compare, though W works.
labels.root_cause: The button only armed the tool instead of running tool.wbPicker.

labels.symptom: The README is only available in English.
The UI pauses for one to two seconds when a large library periodically saves its catalog.
labels.root_cause: Journal compaction serialised and fsynced the whole catalog on the UI thread.

labels.symptom: Thai, Arabic and other non-Latin, non-CJK file and folder names show as empty boxes.
labels.root_cause: The UI font fallback list included only the CJK faces from craft-fonts.

labels.symptom: Setting the crop angle through scripting or the command line lets the crop include empty canvas outside the photo.
labels.root_cause: The generic develop-control path wrote crop.angle without re-fitting the crop to the image.

labels.symptom: Some raw photos render too dark with cream-tinted blown highlights.
labels.root_cause: The white level estimate anchored on stray maximum samples and fell back to the full bit range.

labels.symptom: Crop-mode raw files from one camera develop with a black band down the left side.
labels.root_cause: The recommended crop was ignored when it didn't fit inside the stated active area.

labels.symptom: Raw previews load slowly, especially from network shares, because the whole raw file is read.
labels.root_cause: The preview loader read the entire raw file just to get the embedded JPEG.

labels.symptom: Canon HDR-PQ CR3 raws without an embedded JPEG render about 1.3 EV darker than the camera's own look.
labels.root_cause: With no JPEG preview to fit a camera look, the default tone curve was used.

labels.symptom: Raw files from one camera show purple stripes at the edges and magenta clipped highlights.
labels.root_cause: Optical black columns were kept, and the white level was set above where green saturates.

labels.symptom: The photo grid does work for every visible photo on each frame, even when nothing has changed.
labels.root_cause: Each frame cloned and hashed all visible ids and rebuilt the layout.

labels.symptom: Pressing Return in a confirmation dialog does nothing; you have to click OK.
labels.root_cause: The dialogs didn't map Return to their OK action.

labels.symptom: The sharpening Radius and Detail sliders have no effect and sharpening boosts coarse texture instead of fine edges.
labels.root_cause: The radius and detail parameters were never read, and sharpening used the texture blur band instead of a pixel-scale unsharp mask.

labels.symptom: The live brush mask preview shows gaps between dabs on fast strokes until the mouse is released.
labels.root_cause: The live overlay drew one circle per pointer sample instead of interpolating dabs like the committed stroke.

labels.symptom: Holding a brush still makes the mask edge harder the longer the button is held.
labels.root_cause: The same pointer position was recorded every frame while dragging, and each copy laid another dab.

labels.symptom: Clicking a folder of albums does not show the photos of the albums inside it.
Import has no Move mode for renaming photos and filing them into date folders.
Pressing Esc in a text field or open tool also runs the global Back action instead of only leaving the field or tool.
labels.root_cause: egui takes focus away from the text field before shortcuts are read, so the check for keyboard input in use misses the Esc.

labels.symptom: Flipping the photo while the crop tool is open doesn't show on screen until the tool is closed.
labels.root_cause: The uncropped frame dropped the flip flags.

labels.symptom: Some older Sony raw files are refused as not a readable photo.
labels.root_cause: The Sony probe required raw evidence that these layouts don't have.

labels.symptom: After undoing an album's creation, the view shows an empty grid titled "Album".
labels.root_cause: Each command cleaned up the view source on its own, so undo, redo and reopening skipped that cleanup.

labels.symptom: A smart album that includes itself shows contents that change depending on which album is asked first.
labels.root_cause: The catalog did not enforce the no-loop rule for smart albums.

labels.symptom: Clicking a control whose action is refused does nothing and gives no explanation.
labels.root_cause: UI call sites drop the command result with let _ = app.run(...), so the error only reaches the log.

labels.symptom: On older Intel Macs the window never opens and the log says the parent device is lost.
labels.root_cause: wgpu's indirect-call validation builds a compute pipeline that Intel's Metal compiler fails on, and the device is lost.

labels.symptom: Raw photos that are mostly bright sky render dull and dark compared with the camera JPEG.
labels.root_cause: The partial-look fit leaves out bright pixels, so the sky is in neither the fit nor the acceptance check.

labels.symptom: Information dialogs show Cancel and OK even though there is nothing to confirm.
labels.root_cause: These dialogs were missing from the list of informational dialogs that get a single Close button.

labels.symptom: On small screens, dialogs taller than the window run off screen so the title and OK/Cancel buttons can't be reached.
labels.root_cause: Dialog bodies had no height cap or scroll area tied to the window size.

labels.symptom: The progress and parity docs are out of date.
On Macs with wide-gamut (P3) screens, colours on screen look more saturated than in exported files.
labels.root_cause: wgpu sets CAMetalLayer.colorspace to nil for sRGB surfaces, so macOS does no colour matching and shows sRGB values as if they were P3.

labels.symptom: Reset Edits on a raw sets sharpening and colour noise reduction to zero instead of the import defaults.
labels.root_cause: Reset rebuilt the settings from the generic defaults instead of the photo's camera defaults.

labels.symptom: Some phone DNG files get a grey curved border when lens corrections are on.
labels.root_cause: The WarpRectilinear2 DNG opcode was not parsed, so the trailing WarpRectilinear, which the spec says to skip, was applied instead.

labels.symptom: Slideshow playback has no fades, random order, repeat or playback controls.
There is no map view for showing photos by GPS location.
A notched mouse wheel doesn't zoom or scroll the canvas.
labels.root_cause: Only pinch or Ctrl+wheel zoom was handled; plain line-unit wheel events were ignored.

labels.symptom: Unsafe code sits in app crates instead of an isolated, tested helper crate.
labels.root_cause: The macOS malloc_zone_pressure_relief FFI call lived directly in the app crates.

labels.symptom: Saving the catalog gets slower as the library grows, even when little has changed.
labels.root_cause: Each catalog record stores every default field, and compaction rewrites the whole snapshot on a fixed record count.

labels.symptom: The last toolbar button touches the edge of its pill background.
labels.root_cause: The pill width reserved less space than the button row needs.

labels.symptom: The Info panel shows no map of the photo's location.
Full-frame raw files from one high-resolution camera render with neutral colour instead of the camera's look.
labels.root_cause: The embedded preview decode had a 64 MP pixel cap, so the camera's larger preview was refused.

labels.symptom: Dropdowns and menus use inconsistent arrow icons, and the histogram clipping corners are unclear.
Camera DNGs without a tone curve render noticeably darker in the mid-tones than the camera's own JPEG.
labels.root_cause: DNGs that have no ProfileToneCurve fell back to the generic default tone.

labels.symptom: Slideshow slides have no layout, border, shadow or backdrop options.
With a dialog open, clicks and shortcuts still change things behind it.
labels.root_cause: Dialogs weren't shown on egui's modal layer, and global shortcuts weren't suspended while a dialog was open.

labels.symptom: Version bump to 0.2.0.
Photos can't be dragged onto the map to set their location.
AI Denoise cannot use another computer's graphics card.
Saving a large catalog rewrites the whole snapshot.
Zoomed side-by-side before/after views spill a blurred picture outside their panes.
labels.root_cause: Whole-frame renders weren't clipped to their own pane.

labels.symptom: The app cannot run on iOS, iPadOS or Android.
There is no location filter bar on the map.
A change that failed to save to disk was reported as successful, with no warning to the user.
labels.root_cause: Errors from the journal append were not passed back to the command result.

labels.symptom: Slideshows cannot show overlays such as an identity plate, rating stars, text or a watermark.
Russian translation update.
Large catalogs use a lot of memory for identical develop settings.
labels.root_cause: Every photo held its own copy of the same settings.

labels.symptom: Raw files from a specific camera get no embedded lens distortion correction.
The colour grading wheels are small and imprecise, and they show no exact values.
Some Canon CR3 files open only as the embedded preview.
labels.root_cause: The CRX decoder rejected quantisation step 44.

labels.symptom: Large catalogs grow with records of browsed folders that the user never touched.
The metadata panel shows the thumbnail's compression for raw files.
labels.root_cause: The Compression value was read from IFD0 instead of the raw sub-IFD.

labels.symptom: The export dialog offers only five watermark positions and no way to set the inset.
labels.root_cause: The dialog did not expose all nine positions the watermark renderer already supports, nor its inset setting.

labels.symptom: All smart previews pile up in one directory with tens of thousands of files.
labels.root_cause: Smart preview paths were not split into subdirectories by their hash.

labels.symptom: Exported images come out completely black on integrated GPUs, even though the preview looks correct.
labels.root_cause: GPU errors, device loss and exceeded device limits were not detected, so silently dropped GPU work was returned as a valid black image with no CPU fallback.

labels.symptom: There is no built-in way to back up the library.
Importing a Lightroom catalog larger than 1 GB fails.
labels.root_cause: The whole catalog file is read into one buffer capped at 1 GiB.

labels.symptom: The export dialog has no preview of the watermark.
No Linux riscv64 release download is offered.
Export watermarks have only one inset, so the horizontal and vertical margins can't be set separately.
Saving a few changes in a large catalog rewrites more data than it needs to.
labels.root_cause: Segments were too large by default.

labels.symptom: Export watermarks can't be rotated in 90-degree steps.
The web release zip contains about 100 MB of build artifacts and leaks build paths.
labels.root_cause: The site bundle directory had the same name as a Cargo profile output directory, so host build artifacts landed inside it.

labels.symptom: Smart preview proxies show block steps and a colour shift compared with the original.
labels.root_cause: Proxy JPEGs were encoded at quality 92, which quantises the 8x8 DC coefficients too coarsely.

labels.symptom: On Wayland, automation requests time out while the window is hidden on another workspace or covered by a fullscreen window.
labels.root_cause: Requests are dispatched between frames, and winit's Wayland backend reports visibility as unknown, so eframe's hidden-window repaint fallback never runs.

labels.symptom: Raw files shot in Adobe RGB show dull colours because the embedded preview is read as sRGB.
labels.root_cause: The colour space from the raw's EXIF ColorSpace/InteropIndex was only read from Nikon maker notes, so untagged embedded JPEGs from other makes were decoded as sRGB.

labels.symptom: The crop rotate pointer always bulges upward, whichever side of the box it is on.
A library can't be restored from a backup.
Isolated white dots appear in dark areas of the camera-look render.
labels.root_cause: Restoring luminance with a before/after gain blew up near-black noisy pixels.

labels.symptom: Compressed Nikon NEF raw files show only the embedded preview with the camera look baked in, instead of the raw data.
labels.root_cause: The decoder didn't support Nikon Huffman-compressed NEF, so it fell back to the embedded JPEG preview.

labels.symptom: Panels can now be docked, grouped and floated with shared layouts saved in workspaces.
The roadmap overstates how close the app is to parity with the commercial original.
Restoring from a backup has no menu item and blocks the app while copying.
On Windows, the same folder written with / and \ separators could be treated as two different folders.
After a rename fails partway, photo and sidecar files, catalog paths and Undo/Redo history no longer match.
labels.root_cause: Partly finished rename and rollback moves left sidecar repairs unfinished and history inverses inconsistent.

labels.symptom: HDR exports look darker in the midtones than the SDR render.
labels.root_cause: HDR renders dropped the camera tone curve and used the generic HDR tone map.

labels.symptom: Upgrading with the Windows MSI moves a custom install folder back to Program Files.
labels.root_cause: Older installers recorded only the App Paths entry, not the stored InstallFolder value, so upgrades could not find the previous folder.

labels.symptom: Raw photos from some Canon cameras show a strong magenta cast.
labels.root_cause: The CR2 decoder used a hard-coded RGGB Bayer pattern instead of the file's CR2CFAPattern tag.

labels.symptom: Maintenance commands finish with no visible confirmation.
A selected slider can't be nudged with the mouse wheel or the Up/Down arrow keys.
labels.root_cause: Sliders did not take keyboard focus when selected and ignored wheel input.

labels.symptom: Very large page offsets in queries wrap around on web builds and return the first page.
labels.root_cause: Unchecked `as usize` casts truncate 64-bit values on 32-bit wasm.

labels.symptom: The documented list of gaps is out of date for CR3 support and CI coverage.
Agent build directories named target-* can be accidentally committed.
labels.root_cause: .gitignore did not ignore /target-*/ directories.

labels.symptom: The README's link in the note about Chinese/Japanese fonts points to a private repo and returns 404.
labels.root_cause: The README linked to the non-public storytold/craftrules repo instead of craft-fonts.

labels.symptom: Nikon High Efficiency NEF files open only from their embedded JPEG preview.
labels.root_cause: The raw decoder had no support for Nikon's High Efficiency compression.

labels.symptom: Agent instructions do not point to the shared real-file test corpora.
At 1:1 zoom in Compare and Reference views the photos look soft, so sharpness can't be compared.
labels.root_cause: Those views magnified the whole-frame render, which is capped at 2,560 px, instead of rendering zoom windows for each pane.

labels.symptom: PR CI takes 30-50 minutes because slow FreeBSD and Windows ARM64 jobs run on almost every PR.
labels.root_cause: These workflows were triggered by lockfile changes and by pushes to main.

labels.symptom: Slideshows have no intro or ending title screens.
There are no saved locations on the map.
Opening a Lightroom catalog folder as a library creates an empty library inside it or leaves no library open.
labels.root_cause: Open Library did not recognise Lightroom catalog paths.

labels.symptom: On FreeBSD the RAM size is guessed and memory cards under /media or /mnt are not found.
labels.root_cause: There was no FreeBSD code path for reading RAM (sysctl hw.physmem) or for the device mount points.

labels.symptom: External editor copies are not stacked with their source photo and do not reload after saving unless the app has focus.
There are no slideshow templates and no template browser.
GPS track logs are not drawn on the map and photos can't be auto-tagged from them.
There is no way to show every mask's overlay region at once.
The map view has no keyboard shortcuts, menu, settings or option to hide pins.
Dragging a noise-reduction slider on the CPU is slow.
labels.root_cause: A noise-reduction change invalidated every spatial plane, so all of them were rebuilt on each draft render.

labels.symptom: There is no per-camera colour database for raw rendering.
Exporting as Original or DNG with Remove location info checked still includes GPS and place data.
labels.root_cause: The sidecar/DNG packet kept location fields, and Original exports copied the file byte for byte.

labels.symptom: There is no content-aware fill for removing larger or structured blemishes.
Building previews for many photos is slow.
labels.root_cause: Previews were built one at a time and each file was decoded twice.

labels.symptom: Soft proofing can't use printer ICC profiles.
Slideshows cannot be exported to PDF, JPEG or video.
Lens profile corrections are missing for raws without embedded lens data.
On Windows the uninstaller gives no confirmation and has no option to remove user data.
labels.root_cause: Windows uninstalls an MSI product's own Apps entry without dialogs, so no options or confirmation can show there.

labels.symptom: The app icon uses the old animal artwork instead of the letter monogram.
The MCP export-cancel end-to-end test fails on machines with many cores because the export finishes before the cancel arrives.
labels.root_cause: Parallel export lanes and a 100 ms progress throttle let the whole export finish before the test sends its cancel.

labels.symptom: Tests are not run in CI on Linux x64, macOS or Windows.
labels.root_cause: There is no CI workflow that runs the test suite on mainstream desktop platforms.

labels.symptom: Dropping photos together with their XMP sidecars imports every sidecar as a preset.
labels.root_cause: The window drop handler sent every .xmp file to the preset importer, including sidecars that belong to dropped photos.

labels.symptom: There is no Lights Out mode that dims everything except the photo.
There is no New Library or Open Recent Library command, and nothing shows which library is open.
Folders can't be created on disk and photos can't be moved between folders.
City, state and country can't be filled in from a photo's GPS position.
Themes can't be starred as favourites, and there is no quick menu to switch appearance.
On some Windows machines the app vanishes at startup with no window because of a DX12 shader translation error.
labels.root_cause: FXC fails to compile egui's shaders on DX12, and wgpu's default uncaptured-error handler panics instead of falling back to another backend.

labels.symptom: Typing a value into a slider and pressing Enter or Escape right away is ignored or also triggers app shortcuts, and Reset during an edit is overwritten.
labels.root_cause: The numeric entry widget lost fast keystrokes on its opening release and committed the click-away draft after Reset ran.

labels.symptom: Sending a photo to the companion image editor needs a manually typed path, and saving in that editor does not update the copy.
labels.root_cause: The external-editor hand-off wrote a TIFF that the editor could only save with Save As, and there was no built-in way to find the editor.

labels.symptom: The masking workspace is cluttered and lacks hierarchical component editing.
The Color Range mask's Pick button does nothing, so no colour samples can be added.
labels.root_cause: While the Masking panel is open, clicks go to the mask overlay, which did not handle the colorRange eyedropper tool.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app in the downloaded DMG fails code signature checks and may refuse to open.
labels.root_cause: Extended attributes left over from the build and the DMG packaging step broke the signature, and the final DMG was never checked.

labels.symptom: Importing raw photos into the catalog reads whole files just to get their metadata.
Rotating a photo left or right cuts it off, and the crop stays wrong after rotating back.
labels.root_cause: Rotate changed only the orientation and did not turn the normalized crop rectangle with it.

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated across repos instead of using shared actions.
A folder added as a saved location can no longer be expanded where it also appears under Home.
labels.root_cause: Both tree rows shared one widget id and one open state, keyed only by the path.

labels.symptom: Importing only .cube profiles says "No new presets", and a .cube that fails to import gives no reason.
labels.root_cause: The empty preset import's toast replaced the profile toast, and failed .cube files were skipped silently.

labels.symptom: Closing the AI model setup without installing a model leaves the AI feature toggle checked with a stale "Cancel pending action".
labels.root_cause: The pending request was never cancelled when the setup was dismissed.

labels.symptom: Raw photos imported before their format was supported stay preview-only after an update adds a decoder.
labels.root_cause: The catalog's preview-only flag was never re-checked when the decoder improved.

labels.symptom: Batch merge of 31 contributor fixes covering raw decoding, GPU, UI and metadata.
Photos with equal sort values show up in import order instead of by file name.
labels.root_cause: Ties in the sort were broken by id instead of by file name.

labels.symptom: RAW edits come out inconsistent, many lenses get no automatic correction, and masks can apply to the wrong geometry.
labels.root_cause: DNG planes shared a mean black level, and asynchronous mask results were not checked against geometry changes.

labels.symptom: The vignette style buttons change nothing at default settings.
labels.root_cause: Paint and Color vignettes use the same math, and lightening vignettes ignore the style.

labels.symptom: Batch merge of many contributor changes.
Some menu and settings strings stay in English when Brazilian Portuguese is selected.
labels.root_cause: Rows are missing from the pt-BR catalog.

labels.symptom: Impossible capture dates such as February 30 are accepted from photo metadata.
labels.root_cause: The datetime validator checks the day only against 1-31 and ignores month lengths and leap years.

labels.symptom: Invalid transforms can produce NaN geometry during perspective correction, warping or panorama alignment.
labels.root_cause: The determinant singularity checks treat NaN as non-singular, and the solver never checks that inputs and coefficients are finite.

labels.symptom: Truncated or malformed GPX track files are accepted as if they were valid.
labels.root_cause: The GPX XML reader turned off closing-tag validation and never checked for unclosed elements at the end of the document.

labels.symptom: The desktop app fails to compile on macOS after the glow feature was enabled in eframe.
labels.root_cause: After the glow feature added a GL-context parameter to App::on_exit, the macOS-only menu-bar quit path still called on_exit without it; a separate test also hardcoded /bin/true.

labels.symptom: Camera coverage docs did not list the Leica Q3 as verified.
The desktop app fails to build on macOS.
labels.root_cause: The macOS menu-bar Quit path called eframe::App::on_exit with one argument, but the glow feature makes it take two.

labels.symptom: Holding Alt/Option while dragging the Blacks, Whites or Sharpening sliders doesn't show a clipping or mask preview.
Export can only write to one fixed folder and can't put each photo next to its original.
Workspace clippy fails on newer Rust because of a chunks_exact lint.
labels.root_cause: clippy::chunks_exact_to_as_chunks flags chunks_exact with a constant chunk size.

labels.symptom: Integration batch that merges translations, raw previews, XMP warnings, Apple Photos export, HDR histogram and JPEG XL export.
Holding Alt while dragging the clipping or sharpening sliders shows no diagnostic preview.
labels.root_cause: The clipping and sharpening preview overlays had not been built.
